name: run_agent_graph
description: Start, advance, inspect, or cancel a checkpointed agent graph. Static mode runs a conditional DAG and reduces node outputs into shared state. Dynamic mode selects relevant candidates, propagates messages, and pools a final answer.

action.description: Operation to perform. start requires mode, question, and the matching graph definition; advance, status, and cancel require graph_id. Call advance until the graph is terminal.

graph_id.description: Graph UUID returned by start; required for advance, status, and cancel.

mode.description: Graph strategy for start: static runs static_graph; dynamic runs dynamic_graph.

name.description: Optional graph name for start. Default agent-graph.

question.description: Non-empty problem or objective given to the graph.

max_parallel.description: Maximum concurrent graph tasks. Default 4; clamped to 1..=8.

static_graph.description: Static-mode definition: shared initial state, executable nodes, and conditional dependency edges.

initial_state.description: Initial shared JSON state. Defaults to an empty object.

nodes.description: DAG nodes to execute (maximum 128). Node ids must be unique.

description.description: Short explanation of the node's responsibility.

agent.description: Optional agent profile name for the node task.

model.description: Optional model override for the node task.

inherit.description: Context inherited by the node task: none, all, cwd, memory, history, skills, or a comma-separated combination.

response_schema.description: Optional JSON Schema constraining the node's final output.

output_key.description: Shared-state key receiving the reduced node output. Defaults to the node id.

reducer.description: How to combine this output with the current output_key value. Default replace.

max_retries.description: Maximum retries after a failed node attempt. Default 0.

edges.description: Directed dependencies between nodes (maximum 1024). Defaults to no edges.

condition.description: Optional gate evaluated after the predecessor finishes. Defaults to always.

kind.description: Gate type. output_contains uses text; json_pointer_equals uses pointer and value.

text.description: Substring required in the predecessor output for output_contains.

pointer.description: JSON Pointer into the predecessor output for json_pointer_equals.

dynamic_graph.description: Dynamic-mode definition: candidate agents plus optional topology and pooling policy.

candidates.description: Candidate agents considered for the graph (2 to 16). Candidate ids must be unique.

role.description: Candidate specialty used during relevance scoring and answer generation.

agent.description: Optional agent profile name for this candidate.

model.description: Optional model override for this candidate.

inherit.description: Context inherited by candidate tasks: none, all, cwd, memory, history, skills, or a comma-separated combination.

policy.description: Optional candidate-selection, edge-selection, and final-pooling policy.

min_selected.description: Minimum candidates retained after relevance scoring. Default 2.

max_selected.description: Maximum candidates retained after relevance scoring. Default 4.

edge_threshold.description: Minimum pairwise relevance score for a message edge. Default 0.35.

pool.description: Final-answer strategy: max selects the highest-scored answer; judge asks a pooling agent to synthesize one. Default judge.

pool_agent.description: Optional agent profile for judge pooling.

pool_model.description: Optional model override for judge pooling.
